preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges in a graph with n vertices, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices numbered from 1 to n.
No self-loops are present in the graph.

preconditions.expression: No edge appears more than once in the input
preconditions.description: There are no multiple edges in the graph.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' to indicate whether a string s exists that corresponds to the given graph G.

postconditions.expression: output == 'Yes' ==> len(s) == n and all(c in 'abc' for c in s)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', then the string s must have a length of n and consist only of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.
If the output is 'Yes', then the graph built using the string s must be identical to the given graph G.
